title: Box Scores and Box Plots
body: For this question, assume that the seaborn library has been imported as sns and the matplotlib pyplot library has been imported as plt.\nIshani is a fantasy sports champion who wants to use her data science skills to get a head start next season. She records last season’s players’ team, position, number of games played, and average number of fantasy points per game, storing the results in a DataFrame called players.
